verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Alif-Laaam-Raa; tilka Aayaatul Kitaabi wa Qur-aa-nim Mubeen

translations.text: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.

verses.text_uthmani: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Rubamaa yawaddul lazeena kafaroo law kaanoo muslimeen

translations.text: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.

verses.text_uthmani: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Zarhum yaakuloo wa tatamatta'oo wa yulhihimul amalu fasawfa ya'lamoon

translations.text: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa wa lahaa kitaabum ma'loom

translations.text: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.

verses.text_uthmani: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wa maa yastaakhiroon

translations.text: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa qaaloo yaaa aiyuhal lazee nuzzila 'alaihiz Zikru innaka lamajnoon

translations.text: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.

verses.text_uthmani: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Law maa taateenaa bil malaaa'ikati in kunta minas saadiqeen

translations.text: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"

verses.text_uthmani: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Maa nunazzilul malaaa'i kata illaa bilhaqqi wa maa kaanooo izam munzareen

translations.text: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innaa Nahnu nazalnaz Zikra wa Innaa lahoo lahaa fizoon

translations.text: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad arsalnaa min qablika fee shiya'il awwaleen

translations.text: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

translations.text: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: kazaalika naslukuhoo fee quloobil mujrimeen

translations.text: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Laa yu'minoona bihee wa qad khalat sunnatul awwaleen

translations.text: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa law fatahnaa 'alaihim baabam minas samaaa'i fazaloo feehi ya'rujoon

translations.text: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,

verses.text_uthmani: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ
verses.transliteration: Laqaaloo innamaa sukkirat absaarunaa bal nahnu qawmum mashooroon

translations.text: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad ja'alnaa fissamaaa'i buroojanw wa zaiyannaahaa linnaazireen

translations.text: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa hafiznaahaa min kulli Shaitaanir rajeem

translations.text: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Illaa manis taraqas sam'a fa atba'ahoo shihaabum mubeen

translations.text: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wal arda madadnaahaa wa alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya wa ambatnaa feehaa min kulli shai'im mawzoon

translations.text: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa lakum feehaa ma'aayisha wa mal lastum lahoo biraaziqeen

translations.text: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa im min shai'in illaa 'indanaa khazaaa 'inuhoo wa maa nunazziluhooo illaa biqadarim ma'loom

translations.text: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa arsalnar riyaaha la waaqiha fa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa asqai naakumoohu wa maaa antum lahoo bikhaazineen

translations.text: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa innnaa la nahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa nahnul waarisoon

translations.text: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa la qad 'alimnal mustaqdimeena minkum wa laqad 'alimnal mustaakhireen

translations.text: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka Huwa yahshuruhum; innahoo Hakeem 'Aleem

translations.text: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana min salsaalim min hama im masnoon

translations.text: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.transliteration: Waljaaanna khalaqnaahu min qablu min naaris samoom

translations.text: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa iz qaala Rabbuka lilmalaaa' ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min salsaalim min hama im masnoon

translations.text: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa izaa sawwaituhoo wa nafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen

translations.text: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fasajadal malaaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma'oon

translations.text: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illaaa ibleesa abaaa ai yakoona ma'as saajideen

translations.text: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala yaaa Ibleesu maa laka allaa takoona ma'as saajideen

translations.text: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qaala lam akul li asjuda libasharin khalaqtahoo min salsaalim min hama im masnoon

translations.text: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Qaala fakhruj minhaa fa innaka rajeem

translations.text: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Wa inna 'alikal la'nata ilaa Yawmid Deen

translations.text: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbi fa anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

translations.text: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala fa innaka minal munzareen

translations.text: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.transliteration: Ilaa Yawmil waqtil ma'loom

translations.text: Until the Day of the time well-known."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbi bimaaa aghwaitanee la uzayyinaana lahum fil ardi wa la ughwiyan nahum ajma'een

translations.text: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illaa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen

translations.text: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Qaala haaza Siraatun 'alaiya Mustaqeem

translations.text: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna 'ibaadee laisa laka 'alaihim sultaanun illaa manittaba'aka minal ghaaween

translations.text: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa inna jahannama lamaw'iduhum ajma'een

translations.text: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.

verses.text_uthmani: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ
verses.transliteration: Lahaa sab'atu abwaab; likulli baabim minhum juz'um maqsoom

translations.text: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Innal muttaqeena fee Jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.text: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.

verses.text_uthmani: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin aamineen

translations.text: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa naza'naa ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwaanan 'alaa sururim mutaqaabileen

translations.text: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
verses.transliteration: Laa yamas suhum feehaa nasabunw wa maa hum minhaa bimukhrajeen

translations.text: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Nabbi' 'ibaadeee annneee anal Ghafoorur Raheem

translations.text: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Wa anna 'azaabee uwal 'azaabul aleem

translations.text: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wa nabbi'hum 'an daifi Ibraaheem

translations.text: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala innaa minkum wajiloon

translations.text: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo la tawjal innaa nubashshiruka bighulaamin 'aleem

translations.text: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala abashshartumoonee 'alaaa am massaniyal kibaru fabima tubashshiroon

translations.text: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo bashsharnaaka bilhaqqi falaa takum minal qaaniteen

translations.text: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala wa mai yaqnatu mir rahmati Rabbiheee illad daaaloon

translations.text: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala famaa khatbukum aiyuhal mursaloon

translations.text: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen

translations.text: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illaaa Aala Loot; innaa lamunajjoohum ajma'een

translations.text: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illam ra atahoo qaddarnaaa innahaa laminal ghaabireen

translations.text: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falamma jaaa'a Aala Lootinil mursaloon

translations.text: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala innakum qawmum munkaroon

translations.text: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo bal ji'naaka bimaa kaanoo feehi yamtaroon

translations.text: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa atainaaka bilhaqqi wa innaa lasaadiqoon

translations.text: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa asri bi ahlika biqit'im minal laili wattabi' adbaarahum wa laa yaltafit minkum ahadunw wamdoo haisu tu'maroon

translations.text: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa qadainaaa ilaihi zaalikal amra anna daabira haaa'ulaaa'i maqtoo'um musbiheen

translations.text: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa jaaa'a ahlul madeenati yastabshiroon

translations.text: And the people of the city came rejoicing.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
verses.transliteration: Qaala inna haaa'ulaaa'i daifee falaa tafdahoon

translations.text: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wattaqul laaha wa laa tukhzoon

translations.text: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaalooo awalam nanhaka 'anil 'aalameen

translations.text: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala haaa'ulaaa'i banaateee in kuntum faa'ileen

translations.text: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."

verses.text_uthmani: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.transliteration: La'amruka innahum lafee sakratihim ya'mahoon

translations.text: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa akhazat humus saihatu mushriqeen

translations.text: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.

verses.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
verses.transliteration: Faja'alnaa 'aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa amtamaa 'alaihim hijaaratam min sjijjeel

translations.text: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil lilmutawassimeen

translations.text: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa innahaa labi sabeelim muqeem

translations.text: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayatal lilmu'mineen

translations.text: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa in kaana Ashaabul Aikati lazaalimeen

translations.text: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fantaqamnaa minhum wa innahumaa labi imaamim mubeen

translations.text: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad kazzaba ashaabul Hijril mursaleen

translations.text: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa aatainaahum Aayaatinaa fakaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen

translations.text: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa kaanoo yanhitoona minal jibaali buyootan aamineen

translations.text: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa akhazat humus saihatu musbiheen

translations.text: But the shriek seized them at early morning.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Famaaa aghnaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon

translations.text: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaaa illaa bilhaqq; wa innas Saa'ata la aatiyatun fasfahis safhal jameel

translations.text: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Inna Rabbaka Huwal khallaaqul 'aleem

translations.text: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad aatainaaka sab'am mnal masaanee wal Qur-aanal 'azeem

translations.text: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Laa tamuddanna 'ainaika ilaa maa matta 'naa biheee azwaajam minhum wa laa tahzan 'alaihim wakhfid janaahaka lilmu 'mineen

translations.text: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers

verses.text_uthmani: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.transliteration: Wa qul inneee anan nazeerul mubeen

translations.text: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -

verses.text_uthmani: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Kamaaa anzalnaa 'alal muqtasimeen

translations.text: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
verses.transliteration: Allazeena ja'alul Quraana'ideen

translations.text: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fawa Rabbika lanas'a lannahum ajma'een

translations.text: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

verses.text_uthmani: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: 'Ammaa kaanoo ya'maloon

translations.text: About what they used to do.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fasda' bimaa tu'maru wa a'rid anil mushrikeen

translations.text: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innaa kafainaakal mustahzi'een

translations.text: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Allazeena yaj'aloona ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhar; fasawfa ya'lamoon

translations.text: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad na'lamu annak yadeequ sadruka bimaa yaqooloon

translations.text: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fasbbih bihamdi Rabbika wa kum minas saajideen

translations.text: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
verses.transliteration: Wa'bud Rabbaka hattaa yaatiyakal yaqeen

translations.text: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
